forWhat: The engine has written each skill as what a child can do, and each level as a sentence. Read them, then approve them as written, or change the words first.

layout.shows: Grade, then Topic and Taught, with [[Show]] and [[Clear]].
Skill, Grade, Topic, What a child can do, and the approve button. [[Read the levels]] opens each row.

jobs.title: Approve a skill
steps: Press [[Read the levels]] on a row and read every level.
If the words are right, press [[Approve, as …]]. It is approved in your name.
If not, press [[Change the description and each level's sentence]] and change them first.
On a skill's own page you can also approve one level at a time with [[Approve …]].

buttons.label: Approve, as …
buttons.does: Approves that one skill as written, in your name.
buttons.doesNot: There is no button that approves every skill at once. If the skill changed since you opened the page, nothing is approved.

buttons.label: Change the description and each level's sentence
buttons.does: Opens the page to change the skill's words.
